logp.method_description: Partition coefficients were measured in mixtures of n-octanol and an aqueous phase buffered at physiological pH with a PBS saline solution by the “handshake” method [34], [46], [47]. The solvents were previously saturated with each other and the partition of complexes calculated as log P(A) = log([A]octanol/[A]buffer). Solutions of each compound were prepared and left in a thermostatic bath at 25 °C for 5 min. The solutions were mixed, stirred for 1 min and left to equilibrate in the thermostatic bath for 3 min. The resulting phases were separated after repeating the stirring/equilibration cycle 5 times. The absorbance of the solutions was measured in the UV range 210–290 nm, were the characteristic bands of the pyridinone ring are expected. The concentrations at equilibrium were calculated considering the mean of three essays and by interpolation using calibration curves, previously elaborated in n-octanol/saline PBS solutions.
